items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Billie Holiday would come up and all that

ctx.x: And then, so, but we had a nice, nice two years with this show, Marlon Brando, and I remember we were right next to the Strand Theater, and Basie's band used to come into the Strand and -- I'd have -- well, between this time we'd always go over and hang out with Basie and then Billie Holiday would come up and all that.
Yeah. How about the time you played with Ellington?
